behaviors.prompt: Set up a new SSR web app with a database.
must: Uses TanStack Start for the SSR app and a separate Hono backend in a pnpm monorepo
Uses PostgreSQL with Drizzle v1 RC
Consults references/stack.md before selecting tools, or reflects its choices
mustNot: Installs tools with no present requirement

behaviors.context: An existing React app with TanStack Query. No form library yet.
must: Chooses TanStack Form v2 and resolves a concrete v2 release
Uses the matching React adapter and v2 documentation
mustNot: Substitutes v1 because it is stable

behaviors.context: An existing Vue 3 + Vite app using Pinia and Vue Router.
behaviors.prompt: Add a date picker to the booking page.
must: Keeps Vue and the existing stack
mustNot: Suggests migrating to React or TanStack Router

behaviors.context: A new TypeScript project with CSS Modules and no formatter or linter.
must: Uses Prettier and ESLint, or the acceptable alternatives, as independently runnable commands
mustNot: Runs Prettier through an ESLint plugin
